relevance_note: The study includes an HA20 cohort within the NIH AID cohort ("Smaller cohorts with PAPA (n=18), HA20 (n=14), CANDLE (n=14), and SAVI (n=12) were also followed"), but every HA20 datum is given only as a cohort count or percentage, so no individual with a TNFAIP3 variant is identifiable.
method_note: Read the full Markdown text (including the Supplementary Material section and the Tables and figures section) and applied extract_v6. This is a cross-sectional questionnaire/chart-review study of 425 AID patients across nine diseases; HA20 is one sub-cohort of 14 patients. All HA20 data are group level only: Table 1 gives the HA20 column of cohort demographics/immunomodulation percentages, Table 2 gives HA20 (n=14) urticaria percentages, and Figures 1-4 show group-level bars/violin plots. The only near-individual HA20 statements are unnamed counts ("perioral swelling temporally associated with flare was reported by one family with TRAPS and one patient each with DADA2, HA20, and CANDLE"; "eosinophilic gastroenteritis (EGE) was diagnosed in 2 patients (HA20 and HIDS)"); these name no person and are not tied to a label, a sex, an age or a variant, so no individuals, variants, phenotypic_features or phenotype_checklist rows were emitted and reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant is false. No variant description of any TNFAIP3 variant is printed anywhere in the paper. No cells containing ' / ' stacked values occur in Tables 1 or 2; Table 1's merged header/label cells are repeated across columns by the conversion. The Supplementary Material section contains only supplementary table/figure headings, with no extractable data. publications.cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is recorded as false with span null because the paper makes no statement about earlier reports of these patients, so no verbatim quote can support it. No contradictions were found in the paper.
